method: Unmodified shipped gameplay-benchmark.mjs; three 36-second shopping-street/firefight/park-foliage subset runs per variant, TAA off, identical workload/settings and harness, separate exclusive timing holds. Standard compare at 5 percent p95 threshold. Controls bracket candidate runs; per-bracket drift disclosed. Aggregate frame statistics are medians of three run statistics; counters are means of three per-run averages. Shipped harness forces GODMODE_FRAME_PROFILE=1. Raw reports and logs retained privately.

caveats: Seeded live AI/physics and particles are repeatable workloads, not bit-identical across frame rates or drivers.
Shader and native arena caches retained; first-use pipeline hitches are included after startup warmup.
CPU and GPU monitor means are overlapping engine timings; they must not be added.
